configuration: Replay SSM only; KDA QKV TP1; DP8 EP8 MTP5
main_scope: Two reduced main layers (one KDA and one SFA), 20 forwards, 8 ranks; no draft kernels in operator panels.
single_call_mean: Original two-call forward sum / 2; averages KDA-MoE and SFA-MoE invocations, does not select a specific layer.

rank_aggregation.Dispatch: Min across 8 ranks per matched invocation, then mean over 40 invocations.
rank_aggregation.Combine: Min across 8 ranks per matched invocation, then mean over 40 invocations.
rank_aggregation.others: 8-rank mean; other panels sum all same-type calls per forward as marked in titles.

communication_scope: Dispatch/Combine measure fused kernel duration, excluding separate HCCL; fastest-rank kernel duration is not collective completion latency.
full_layer_shares: Estimated operator time in 45 main layers + 5 draft calls / calibrated EP8 ITL; shares unchanged by display normalization; overlapping work/wait not allocated, shares need not sum to 100%.
MFU_MBU: Existing Top10 estimates retained; work and time use consistent aggregation, so display division by2 does not change ratios. Six additional operators carry bound and full-layer shares only.
GMM_MBU: Balanced-expert cold-read estimate; values over100% hidden.
bound: Profiler pipeline activity heuristic, not proven critical-path bottleneck. Annotation batches1,14,28,44,60; selected fastest ranks used for Dispatch/Combine.
full_ITL: Existing EP8 calibrated model unchanged; EP16/32 conditional estimates halve/quarter GMM contribution only; no multi-host measurements. 850E B61-80 extrapolated. No accepted-step normalization.
extra_points_source: B14 and B44:32 original profiler CSVs,8ranks x20main forwards; no interpolation. B28/B60 recalculated with40 existing metric points unchanged.
input_sequence_label: 128K input tokens per request; decode context grows with generation; not per-step6B tokens.
